DILG Republic Of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http:llwww.d dg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 10 s. 2021 09 Feb 2021 HON. ANTONIO A. AURELIO, DPA Municipal Vice Mayor 2/F Municipal Bldg., Barangay West Poblacion Rizal, Laguna Dear Vice-Mayor Aurelio.: This has reference to your letter dated 06 November 2020, seeking this Department's opinion regarding the following, which we quote in toto: I. What are the repercussions if the Sangguniang Kabataan fails to submit the Annual Budget and the Annual Barangay Youth Investment Plan which is subject for adoption by the Sangguniang Bayan as per Section 20(d) of RA 10742? 2. If the Sangguniang Kabataan submitted their Annual Budget and Annual Barangay Youth Investment Program in the last quarter of the current year, can the Sangguniang Bayan defer the adoption of the said documents because it is already late in the year that the said crucial documents are endorsed subject to Section 3.3.3.4 of DBM-DILG-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. I , s. 2019, which prescribe guidelines on the release, appropriation, planning and budgeting process of SK funds? With regard to the we find Section 18(a)(4) of the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of Republic Act (RA) No. 10742, otherwise known as "Sangguniang Kabtaan Reform Act of 2015" instructive: "Section 18. Suspension and Removal from Office.—(a) Any elected official of the SK may, after due process, be suspended, for not more than six (6) months or removed from office by majority vote of all members of the sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan which has jurisdiction over the barangay of the concerned SK official which shall be final and executory on any of the following grounds: (4) Failure to formulate the CBYDP and the Annual Baranqay Youth Investment Program (ABYIP). or approve the annual budget within the prescribed period of time without justifiable reason; xxxx (Emphasis Supplied)

With respect to the we answer in the negative. Item No. 3.3.1.3 of DBM-DILG-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 1, Series of 2019, states that the ABYIP shall be prepared and approved by the SK through a resolution before the start of the preparation of the SK annual budget, specifically within ten (10) days after the adoption of the CBYDP, on or before September 301. In accordance therewith, the annual budget of the SK shall be prepared in harmony with the approved ABYIP2, and the resolution thereof should be passed before the beginning of the ensuing year3. It is to be noted, however, that the budget cycle of the SK shall be synchronized with that of the barangay. As such, the SK Chairperson shall submit the proposed SK annual budget to the SK members not later than the 16th day of October of the current year for budget authorization purposes4. Consequently, the approved SK annual budget shall be subject to the review by the sangguniang panglunsod or sangguniang bayan. as the case may be. within sixty (60) days upon receipt thereof on their compliance with Section 20(c) of Republic Act No. 10742, and other existing laws, rules and regulations. Non-compliance shall render said budgets inoperative either in whole or in part5. Failure on the part of the sanggunian concerned to complete the review within the prescribed period shall render the said budget deemed approved. (Underscoring Supplied) It bears to stress, however, that if there is an appropriated budget then the SK funds shall be utilized according to the same pursuant to Section 336 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as "Local Government Code of 1991" (LGC). On the other hand, if there is a failure to enact annual appropriations then re-enacted budgets will be in operation. On re-enacted budgets, however, there exists a limitation7 Section 323 of LGC states: SECTION 323. Failure to Enact the Annual Appropriations. — In case the sanggunian concerned fails to pass the ordinance authorizing the annual appropriations at the beginning of the Item No. 10.2.4, National Youth Commission (NYC) Resolution No. 46, Series of 2019, entitled Resolution Approving the Guidelines on Local Youth Development Planning, Comprehensive Barangay Youth Development Planning, and Annual Barangay Youth Investment Programming" 2 Item No. 3.3.2.1, DBM-DILG-NYC Joint Memorandu Circular No. 1, Series of 2019 3 Item No. 3.3.3.1, Ibid. 4 Item No. 3.3.2.4, Ibid. 5 Section 20(d) of RA 10742 in relation to Item 3.3.4.1, DBM-DILG-NYC Joint Memorandu Circular No. 1 , Series of 2019 7 DILG Legal Opinion No. 09, Series of 2020

ensuing fiscal year, it shall continue to hold sessions, without additional remuneration for its members, until such ordinance is approved, and no other business may be taken up during such sessions. If the sanggunian still fails to enact such ordinance after ninety (90) days from the beginning of the fiscal year, the ordinance authorizing the appropriations of the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and shall remain in force and effect until the ordinance authorizing the proposed appropriations is passed by the sanggunian concemed. However, only the annual appropriations for salaries and wages of existing positions, statutory and contractual obligations, and essential operating expenses authorized in the annual and supplemental budgets for the preceding year shall be deemed reenacted and disbursement of funds shall be in accordance therewith. In the implementation of such reenacted ordinance, the local treasurer concerned shall exclude from the estimates of income for the preceding fiscal year those realized from nonrecurring sources, like national aids, proceeds from loans, sale of assets, prior year adjustments, and other analogous sources of income. No ordinance authorizing supplemental appropriations shall be passed in place of the annual appropriations. In case the revised income estimates be less than the aggregate reenacted appropriations, the local treasurer concerned shall accordingly advise the sanggunian concerned which shall, within ten (10) days from the receipt of such advice, make the necessary adjustments or reductions. The revised appropriations authorized by the sanggunian concerned shall then be the basis for disbursements. Clearly, the ABYIP shall be submitted on or before September 30, and the annual budget can be submitted during the last quarter of the year but not later than October 16. Otherwise, the concerned SK member may be subjected to cases which would lead to his removal or suspension as discussed above. Corollary, the Sangguniang Bayan cannot defer the review of the SK's budget. To reiterate, non-compliance shall render said budgets inoperative either in whole or in part. And, failure on the part of the sanggunian concerned to complete the review within the prescribed period shall render the said budget deemed approved. We hope to have sufficiently addressed your concerns. Thank you. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secret TIN B. DIN Undersecretary for Barangay Affairs LegaL91 Copy fumished: DIR. ARIEL O. IGLESIA Regional Director, DILG-Region IV-A (CALABARZON) 3d Floor. Anderson Bldg. l. Brgy. Parian. Calamba City
